enemies.name: Norport Civilian
enemies.flavour_text: Ordinary folk scattered throughout Norport Borough. Abandoned by Londinium and subjected to the Sarkaz's high-handed blockade, these orphans have become the ones most deeply affected by the haze of war.

abilities.text: Friendly Unit
Once their identity is confirmed, restores your max DP after retreating to the Objective Point

enemies.name: Norport Spy
enemies.flavour_text: Military spies disguised as civilians in Norport Borough, lacking the communication channels to pass on their abundant intel. They were already helping their Dukes learn about their rivals before the borough broke off from Londinium, and have seamlessly transitioned to spying on the Sarkaz Army's movements after the Military Commission seized control.

abilities.text: Friendly Unit
Once their identity is confirmed, restores your max DP after retreating to the Objective Point

enemies.name: Pathfinder Spy
enemies.flavour_text: A spy hired by a mysterious employer to monitor their rivals while disguised as civilians. Most are amateurs at gathering intelligence, and their impulsiveness and unorthodox practices often expose the secrets they think they're keeping safe.

abilities.text: Spy
When their identity is revealed, the next attack's ATK is greatly increased

enemies.name: Pathfinder Spymaster
enemies.flavour_text: A spy hired by a mysterious employer to monitor their rivals while disguised as civilians. These seasoned operatives will occasionally employ less orthodox methods to get their more impatient rivals to let down their guard.

abilities.text: Spy
When their identity is revealed, the next attack's ATK is greatly increased

enemies.name: Sentry Spy
enemies.flavour_text: A spy hired by a mysterious employer to monitor their rivals while disguised as civilians. They have obviously undergone professional intelligence training, and the complexity of the blockade taught them even more about carefully observing their environment.

abilities.text: Spy
When their identity is revealed, becomes Invisible

enemies.name: Sentry Spymaster
enemies.flavour_text: A spy hired by a mysterious employer to monitor their rivals while disguised as civilians. They know the blockade inside-out, and prefer to first gather enough crucial information before proceeding to the next step of their plans.

abilities.text: Spy
When their identity is revealed, becomes Invisible

enemies.name: Armed Spy
enemies.flavour_text: A spy hired by a mysterious employer to sabotage their rivals while disguised as civilians. They are more or less professional soldiers with training in gathering intelligence, and their reliable weaponry and ample combat experience make them even more of a threat.

abilities.text: Spy

enemies.name: Armed Spymaster
enemies.flavour_text: A spy hired by a mysterious employer to sabotage their rivals while disguised as civilians. They use their sharp intuition to judge the appropriate time to join the fray, and are able to resolutely execute their well-prepared plans.

abilities.text: Spy

enemies.name: Sarkaz Absurdist Operative
enemies.flavour_text: Operatives attached to the Military Commission, specializing in gathering intelligence and softening the enemy frontlines. The actual leaders of this unit are a mystery, and are surprisingly always the first to show up wherever the Military Commission is operating.

abilities.text: Attacks reduce DP when carrying ammo. Ammo capacity: 3

enemies.name: Sarkaz Absurdist Operative Leader
enemies.flavour_text: Operatives attached to the Military Commission, primarily tasked with assassinating high-value targets. When on a mission, they often arrive before their subordinates to soften the enemy frontlines with incredible speed, while simultaneously planning their next action.

abilities.text: Attacks reduce DP when carrying ammo. Ammo capacity: 3

enemies.name: Sarkaz Absurdist Splitcaster Apprentice
enemies.flavour_text: A product of the cooperation between the Damazti Cluster and the Military Commission. Under the guidance of the Damazti Cluster, these extraordinarily gifted Sarkaz have learned to split themselves in two with Arts. However, every split places a heavy burden on the caster's body, and each imperfect replica merely makes them an easier target on the battlefield.

abilities.text: When HP is below half, creates a <Virtual Image> at their location

enemies.name: Sarkaz Absurdist Splitcaster
enemies.flavour_text: A product of the cooperation between the Damazti Cluster and the Military Commission, able to effortlessly split themselves in two with Arts. They can easily adapt their imperfect replicas to draw the enemy's attention and give themselves an advantage.

abilities.text: When HP is below half, creates a <Virtual Image> at their location

enemies.name: Rebellion Instigator
enemies.flavour_text: Disruptors that constantly bypass the blockade. They weaken the enemy's forces from within by eagerly sowing fear among the masses, who in their panic break down the borough defenses all on their own.

abilities.text: When not blocked, all unrevealed Civilians or Spies cannot be blocked

enemies.name: Rebellion Agitator
enemies.flavour_text: Disruptors that constantly bypass the blockade. They weaken the enemy's forces from within by taking the initiative to whip the masses into a frenzy, who in turn break down the borough defenses all on their own.

abilities.text: When not blocked, all unrevealed Civilians or Spies cannot be blocked

enemies.name: Sarkaz Absurdist Tyrant
enemies.flavour_text: A product of the cooperation between the Damazti Cluster and the Military Commission. Under the guidance of the Damazti Cluster, these Sarkaz soldiers have learned to use transformation Arts to appear more intimidating. However, the body affects the mind, and their lack of rationality makes them even more brutal in battle.

abilities.text: Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block
First attack deals Splash damage

enemies.name: Sarkaz Absurdist Tyrant Captain
enemies.flavour_text: A product of the cooperation between the Damazti Cluster and the Military Commission, able to change their appearance with Arts. They can skillfully manipulate their flesh without damaging their brains, and are used to employing their intimidating forms to gain an advantage in battle.

abilities.text: Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block
First attack deals Splash damage

enemies.name: Withering Collector Disciple
enemies.flavour_text: An organic construct containing the Nachzehrer King's Originium Arts. It can extract all kinds of dead souls from the battlefield to create Seeds of Withering.

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Periodically summons several <Seeds of Withering>

enemies.name: Decaying Collector Disciple
enemies.flavour_text: An organic construct containing the Nachzehrer King's Originium Arts. It can extract all kinds of dead souls from the battlefield to create Seeds of Decay.

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Periodically summons several <Seeds of Decay>

enemies.name: 'Trilby Asher'
enemies.flavour_text: 'Forever honor one's commitments,' the proud motto of House Caster. While the Duke's military and political might are more than enough to back their word, the 'Trilby Ashers' are the real reason why the Duke of Caster's words hold any weight.

abilities.text: After several attacks, moves towards the next checkpoint for the next attack

enemies.name: 'Shadowing Trilby Asher'
enemies.flavour_text: To the Duke of Caster, a 'Trilby Asher' is more of a consumable than a collectible. On the day a 'Trilby Asher' is honored with the job, another 'Shadowing Trilby Asher' is also born—only succeeding their predecessor when their mentor dies.

abilities.text: After several attacks, moves towards the next checkpoint for the next attack

enemies.name: Deconstructed Distortion
enemies.flavour_text: The Damazti Cluster has spent their long life trying to study themselves. This intelligent and audacious long-lived has tried to surmount the limitations of the flesh and bestow life to inanimate objects, but 'immortality' remains a difficult premise to prove.

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Attacks inflict Corrosion; loses HP every second

enemies.name: Eblana
enemies.flavour_text: Leader of Dublinn, the Draco who burns through all facades.

enemies.name: 'Damazti Cluster'
enemies.flavour_text: The long-lived that wanders outside the Sarkaz Royal Court, facing the path of flame.

enemies.name: 'Damazti Cluster'
enemies.flavour_text: A long-lived that has drifted away from the Sarkaz Royal Court. They have taken the rise and fall of the various races as a sort of life experience, but the Damazti Cluster has yet to find the answer to what 'living' means.

abilities.text: Spy
Whenever a certain percentage of HP is lost, summons an Isomorphic Fragment on an Operator or on the field that shares HP with self;
Both the Damazti Cluster and Isomorphic Fragments take reduced Physical and Arts damage for every Isomorphic Fragment present on the field
Both the Damazti Cluster and Isomorphic Fragments are Invulnerable while their identities have yet to be revealed
Attacks inflict Corrosion
First Form
Periodically releases [Derivative Iteration]: both the Damazti Cluster and Isomorphic Fragments simultaneously deal Physical damage to a target
When defeated for the first time, deals continuous Arts damage to all units around Damazti Cluster or Isomorphic Fragments while regenerating itself
Second Form

Periodically releases [Lifeline Burst] which locks onto all allies on the field, and after a period of time deals Arts damage to the targets and any allies in the adjacent 4 tiles and summons a Deconstructed Distortion on the locked-on positions

When HP falls below a certain percentage during second form, summons an Isomorphic Fragment lurking amongst your operators, targeting an operator that will be forced off the battlefield after summoning is complete. Prioritizes units without allies in adjacent spaces
